scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.2 / LGRA.2.9.6.9 — an interpolation body is a name or path; `{len(t.entity_id)}` is an inline call, so the span is not a valid interp_body and is DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_PATH, never literal text. Drives the Mercury compiler's single site scanner (dsc.strlit) on a body whose leading NAME is followed by `(`, and must not reach a call lowering in dsc.rete.site. The `let n = len(t.entity_id)` then `{n}` form is the admitted spelling.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r_len:
    T t
->
    log info "payload has {len(t.entity_id)} chars"
